body:
Every commercial establishment operating within West Bengal municipal jurisdictions must hold a valid Certificate of Enlistment (Trade License) under the West Bengal Municipal Act, 1993.

Required Statutory Documentation:
• Proof of occupancy (Rent Agreement, Municipal Tax Receipt, or Possession Letter).
• Fire safety NOC (for industrial and storage units).
• Pollution Control Board consent (if categorized as green/orange industry).
• Annual Professional Tax Challan via GRIPS portal.

Ensure renewal filings are executed before the annual statutory municipal cutoff to prevent sealings and compounding penalties.
title: Municipal Trade License Registration & GRIPS Portal Compliance in WB
summary: Essential guidance for obtaining and renewing Certificates of Enlistment across Baidyabati, Serampore, and Kolkata.
